fields.description: Select only when an operator-approved record identifies the named development or park. Leave blank when compound membership is unknown.

fields.name: subunits

fields.description: Add the checked-in filename slug for each published subunit. Each slug must point to an existing property record of the same type.

fields.name: buildingFeatures
fields.label: Approved amenities / features
fields.description: Operator-approved building or unit features only. Do not copy third-party listing claims or infer amenities from stock photography.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Address
fields.description: Include the zone + road + kilometer mark. e.g. "Mlolongo, Mombasa Road, KM 14".

fields.name: sqft
fields.label: Square footage
fields.description: Render in JetBrains Mono. e.g. "9,000 sq ft".

fields.name: ksh

fields.description: Total annual or sale price in KSH.

fields.name: perSqft

fields.name: reference
fields.label: Reference code (mono)
fields.description: On-paper code shown beneath the availability badge. e.g. EE-MLO-014.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Site Identity & SEO
fields.description: Site-wide identity. These values appear on every page. The Site Name is shown in the header navigation and used as the default browser title; the Description is the default for search results and social shares. The Email and Office fields are the single source of truth for contact links and appointment requests.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Shown in the header navigation on every page. Lives in Global Config because it is the same site-wide. Each page sets its own browser title through the Meta Title field.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Default Meta Description (SEO)
fields.description: Default description shown in search results and social-sharing previews when a page does not provide its own.

fields.name: siteOwner
fields.label: Site Owner (shown in footer)
fields.description: Your name or company name. Displayed in the site footer.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown next to the Site Name in the header navigation.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email (single source of truth)
fields.description: Primary inbox used by viewing requests, document requests, and fallback contact copy.

fields.name: office
fields.label: Office address (single source of truth)
fields.description: Operator office location. Referenced in the footer + about page contact section.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation Menu
fields.description: Short header links for the Eens Business Park site. Keep each link tied to a live route or real contact action.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Link Label
fields.description: The short label shown in the header, such as Listings or Leasing.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: A live internal route or a real contact URL. Keep this aligned with the public Eens Business Park sitemap.

fields.name: icon

fields.description: Any Tabler icon name, e.g. tabler:brand-x, tabler:book-2, tabler:brand-github. Browse at https://icones.js.org/collection/tabler
